author: Codex
task: Reusable layered leather wallet pattern, sewing, thickness and export workflow

preflight.gap: No Marvelous-specific workflow found in library index/tool list; old app versus current web manuals requires explicit version limits.

environment_evidence.scope: Exact named running process, main window title and executable version metadata only

sources.title: Polygon
sources.finding: Polygon closure and numeric segment length; ver5.1.0 note distinguished from live compatibility.

sources.title: Internal Polygon/Line
sources.read_scope: Objective, Location, Operation, Length/Position and Notes
sources.finding: Internal shapes/lines locate construction features but do not themselves cut openings.

sources.title: Convert to Hole/Internal Shape
sources.read_scope: Objective, Location, Operation for both conversions
sources.finding: Internal shape can become a hole; zero-width slit from a single open line is not established.

sources.title: Segment Sewing (2D)
sources.read_scope: Objective, Location, Operation and all Notes
sources.finding: Segment pairs and parallel direction notches; crossed directions can reverse a panel; 1-inch warning is not a wallet tolerance.

sources.title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Physical Property Detail Setting
sources.read_scope: Complete short main body and both numeric input notes
sources.finding: Interdependent material settings; slider stages differ from constant input.

sources.title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Bending-Weft/Warp
sources.finding: Bending resistance and independent pattern axes; no target leather calibration.

sources.title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Stretch-Weft/Warp, Shear
sources.finding: Horizontal, vertical and shear resistance are separate from bending.

sources.title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Collision Thickness
sources.read_scope: Objective, Note, Location, Operation and 2026.1 update
sources.finding: Invisible collision spacing differs from display thickness; new direction update excluded from MD9.

sources.title: FABRIC PHYSICAL PROPERTIES: Adjust Rendering Thickness
sources.read_scope: Objective, Note, Fabric/Pattern Location and Operation
sources.finding: Visible thickness is separate from collision; inspect actual exported section.

sources.title: 3D File (OBJ) Import/Export
sources.read_scope: OBJ objective/location/import/export tables and Load as Garment/Morph/Trim/Avatar bodies
sources.finding: Object separation, weld, thickness, units and UV trace are distinct; 2026-specific option excluded; Trim collision caveat.

cross_review.sewing_vs_shape: Internal lines and simulated seams do not automatically create open slots or visible thread geometry.
cross_review.thickness: Collision spacing and visible rendering thickness differ. Current collision article Operation uses rendering wording; Objective/Location and separate rendering article clarify the distinction.
cross_review.version: Web revisions 2025-2026 are not blanket MD9 compatibility evidence; 2026.0 Turned weld and 2026.1 collision-direction improvement excluded.
cross_review.scale: Existing educational examples and collision defaults are not target wallet measurements or tolerances.

application: Manual and private preliminary cutting/assembly plan only. Private product assets and paths omitted.
